style: High-end stylized 3D animated feature film. Appealing, exaggerated cartoon proportions; big expressive eyes; smooth painted skin with soft subsurface glow; simple sculpted hair shapes; rich warm cinematic lighting with soft shadows and gentle rim light; shallow depth of field; smooth, weighty, expressive character animation with clear acting and readable facial expressions. Ancient Greece. No text, no captions, no logos.
voice: Natural, warm, conversational English voices with lip-sync to the quoted dialogue. No background music unless the shot says so.

mikon.name: Mikon
mikon.sheet: A stocky, pear-shaped Greek man in his forties: short legs, round belly, broad soft shoulders, big friendly hands. Round face, large warm brown eyes, a big bulbous nose, thick expressive black eyebrows, short black curly hair thinning on top, dark stubble, olive skin, a gap-toothed grin. Wears a coarse undyed oatmeal wool tunic tied with a brown rope belt and worn leather sandals. A salt-fish seller who laughs at his own jokes.
mikon.voice: warm, slightly husky baritone, cheerful, chuckles easily

lykon.name: Lykon
lykon.sheet: Mikon's best friend: a tall, lanky, long-necked Greek man in his thirties with big ears, a long thin face, worried eyebrows, a nervous smile and messy brown hair. Faded sage-green tunic too short for him.

kleio.name: Kleio
kleio.sheet: Mikon's aunt: a short, round, formidable Greek woman in her sixties with sharp clever eyes, a strong nose, grey hair pinned up under a navy-blue veil, a navy silk dress and a string of gold beads. Bossy, loving, always holding something.
kleio.voice: crisp, commanding older woman's voice, dry wit

demeas.name: Demeas
demeas.sheet: Mikon's uncle: a huge barrel-chested bald Greek man in his sixties with a bushy white beard, rosy cheeks, a booming laugh and tiny eyes that vanish when he smiles. Cream tunic with a plum-purple cloak, always holding a wine cup.
demeas.voice: booming, jolly bass, a bit tipsy

thea.name: Thea
thea.sheet: The bride, Mikon's cousin: a petite young Greek woman with huge amber eyes, freckles, a short glossy auburn bob, a myrtle wreath, and a saffron-gold silk wedding gown with a gold collar and gold cuffs. Warm, quick, a little bossy.

nikias.name: Nikias
nikias.sheet: The groom: a tall, gentle, slightly awkward young Greek man with soft brown curls, kind eyes and big ears, a white tunic and a myrtle wreath.

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.sheet: The messenger god, young-looking and slim, with a sly charming grin, bright quick eyes and tousled light-brown hair under a wide-brimmed traveller's hat with two small white wings. Short white tunic, a red cloak pinned with a gold brooch, winged sandals, and a herald's staff with two snakes curled round it. Moves lightly, never quite still.
hermes.voice: light, smooth, amused young man's voice, a little mischievous

charon.name: Charon
charon.sheet: The ferryman of the dead: very tall and gaunt, stooped, in a ragged dark-brown hooded robe; a long craggy grey-bearded face, deep-set eyes that glow faintly like embers, long bony hands, and a long black punting pole. Dry, weary, quietly funny.
charon.voice: very deep, slow, gravelly old voice

orpheus.name: Orpheus
orpheus.sheet: A slim, long-limbed Greek musician in his late twenties with soft dark wavy hair to his jaw, gentle dark eyes, a shy crooked smile and long expressive fingers. Cream tunic, a dark-blue cloak, and a small wooden lyre with a tortoise-shell sound box that he always carries.

eurydice.name: Eurydice
eurydice.sheet: Orpheus's bride: a lively young Greek woman with big hazel eyes, a light dusting of freckles, long wavy chestnut hair, a myrtle wreath, and an ivory silk wedding gown with a gold beaded collar and long bell sleeves. Laughs with her whole face; teasing, brave, impatient.
eurydice.voice: lively, playful young woman's voice with a laugh in it

hymen.name: Hymen
hymen.sheet: Hymen, god of weddings: a plump, beaming, round-faced god with rosy cheeks and a curly golden beard, in flowing saffron robes, holding a wooden wedding torch.

melitta.name: Melitta
melitta.sheet: Eurydice's best friend: a sunny young Greek woman with a blonde braid and a pale-blue dress, always running somewhere.

places.corinth: A festive Greek courtyard wedding at dusk in Corinth: whitewashed walls, a vine-covered pergola with hanging grapes, garlands, flickering torches, long tables with bread, olives, lamb and wine, a crowd of guests in colourful clothes dancing, laughing and eating.
places.styx: The bank of the River Styx in the Underworld: a vast dark cavern, a wide river glowing faint blue-green, a long wooden dock, mist, drifting pale lights, a marble colonnade along the bank.
places.thrace: A spring wedding in Thrace in bright morning light: a white courtyard, a pergola heavy with vines, garlands, guests in bright clothes, and beyond the gate a meadow of long grass and wildflowers running down to a sparkling stream.
places.taenarum: A sea cave at Taenarum: layered red-orange sandstone carved into smooth ridges, opening on a calm sea at sunrise, the light fading into darkness deeper in.
